services.desc: Fish the shallow flats of Virginia Beach, Virginia, USA on this 4-hour inshore trip focused on targeting Redfish (Red Drum). This trip is ideal for anglers looking for a shorter, action-focused outing while still covering productive waters. With morning and afternoon departures available, you’ll work shallow structure, grass flats, and tidal zones where Redfish are commonly found. All rods, reels, bait, and tackle are provided, along with guidance to help improve casting accuracy and presentation. This trip is well-suited for beginners and experienced anglers who want a quick, efficient fishing experience without committing to a full day on the water. Enjoy a focused 6-hour bay fishing trip

blurb: Puttin'n Sportsfishing offers top-rated Virginia Beach inshore fishing charters, specializing in Redfish, Cobia, and Flounder fishing trips. Whether you’re looking for an exciting inshore fishing trip in Virginia Beach, a scenic creek fishing charter, or a hands-on light tackle fishing experience, Captain Preston Hukill provides expert Virginia Beach fishing guide services tailored to anglers of all skill levels.
